title: Website Launch & Language Selection
content: The new Rainbowsaurus Games website is officially live! Complete with mobile optimization, a hidden drawing canvas, and automatic language switching.

title: Gamescom 2026 Recap
content: Wow, what a week in Cologne! It was great to connect with other indie developers and gather lots of fresh motivation for the continued development of Wandersoul.

title: Buggy Juice Kicks Off
content: The starting signal for the 'One last night' Game Jam has been fired! We are experimenting with custom shaders and super sweet animations for our little arcade project.

title: First Combat System Tests & New Sprites
content: The basic architecture for the combat system in C# is in place! I did the first test runs today. More details and gameplay GIFs can be found in the new devlog on itch.io.
caption: Wandersoul: First UI concept for the room.

title: Productivity Made Easy
content: Code refactoring is going especially well today. Mochi has taken over quality control on the desk.
